sourceNote: Based on the real Kelty Hearts 3-2 Brora Rangers match, 21 July 2026 (Premier Sports Cup group stage). Goal scorers, minutes and final score are real; commentary lines between events are written for demo pacing.

events.text: Kick-off! Kelty Hearts vs Brora Rangers is underway at New Central Park.

events.detail: a well-taken finish to open the scoring
events.text: GOAL! Ryan Shanley opens the scoring for Kelty Hearts. 1-0.
Brora pushing for a way back in but Kelty's defence is standing firm.

events.detail: a composed finish to level the game
events.text: GOAL! James Wallace equalises for Brora Rangers. 1-1.
GOAL! Ryan Shanley grabs his second to restore Kelty's lead. 2-1.
Brora start the second half on the front foot, looking for a way back into the tie.
GOAL! Shane Sutherland levels it again for Brora Rangers. 2-2.
Substitution for Kelty Hearts: Finlay Moffat is introduced from the bench.

events.detail: a poked finish from inside the box after good work from captain Jack Brydon
events.text: GOOOOOAAALLLLLLL! It's Finlay Moffat who scores a dramatic stoppage-time winner! 3-2.
FULL TIME: Kelty Hearts 3-2 Brora Rangers. A dramatic late winner from substitute Finlay Moffat sends Kelty through.
